caption: The drawing depicts a single white bonnet positioned in profile, oriented towards the right side of the paper. The bonnet features a rounded crown with a circular pattern composed of small, evenly spaced floral or star-shaped motifs, distributed across the surface. The edge of the bonnet near the front is adorned with two narrow parallel bands and a wider decorative band that contains a repeating pattern of leaves and vines, likely embroidered. The entire bonnet is rendered in fine, delicate lines with minimal shading, and the overall color of the drawing is off-white or cream, with the decorative elements marked in a slightly darker shade, appearing as pale gray or light brown ink. The background is plain, and unornamented, with no additional objects or elements present. The artist's signature, "Sally Towner," is located in the lower right corner.
title: Baby's Bonnet
